items.headline: Week 2 NFL highlights: Best plays, moments, touchdowns, more
items.description: Check out the best of the best from Week 2 around the NFL, including highlight-reel touchdowns and must-see plays.

items.headline: Sources: 49ers owner Jed York won't attend home opener
items.description: 49ers owner Jed York, who was in Australia but did not attend his team's regular-season opener, also will miss Sunday's home opener in San Francisco against the Dolphins, sources told ESPN.

items.headline: NFL Week 2 uniforms: Rams debut 'Classic Sol,' Ravens go all-white
items.description: Here's a look at what each NFL team is wearing in Week 2, led by a new alternate look from the Los Angeles Rams.

items.headline: How the 49ers are readjusting after weeklong Australia trip
items.description: On their 16-hour flight home from Australia, the 49ers chose sleep over celebration. That kick-started a long week of getting back into routine.

items.headline: 49ers focused on avoiding Week 2 letdown vs. Dolphins
items.description: Nick Wagoner explains how San Francisco is guarding against a letdown against Miami.

items.headline: FBI case against fake 49ers player adds more alleged victims
items.description: The FBI has identified 35 additional women who say they were defrauded by Daejon Love and Taylor Chan, bringing the total number of alleged victims in a case that included Love impersonating as a 49ers player to more than 60.
